designationHistory.indexText: Congress established the Yukon Flats National Wildlife Refuge, about 8,630,000 acres, in the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act, which President Jimmy Carter signed on December 2, 1980.

authority.citation: Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act, Public Law 96-487, sec. 302(9), 94 Stat. 2371

designationHistory.note: Pass A (FWS Realty establishment record and fws.gov: created in 1980 by ANILCA) and Pass B (statute text, sec. 302(9), in the Statutes at Large on govinfo) agree. FWS says the area had been designated a national monument in December 1978 and that ANILCA dropped the monument designation and created the refuge; the 1978 monument action was not separately verified here.

sources.name: Public Law 96-487 (Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act), 94 Stat. 2371, Dec. 2, 1980, sec. 302
